title: vitex trifolia var. obovata
intro: Vitex trifolia var. obovata, commonly known as the Chaste Tree, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used to support women's health, particularly in menstrual irregularities, menopausal symptoms, and fertility issues, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Vitex trifolia var. obovata include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which contribute to its ability to alleviate menstrual cramps, regulate hormonal balances, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, such as vitexin, agnuside, and scopoletin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
